brief: Halde & Sons, a small specialty coffee roaster, is releasing a new single-origin coffee: Ethiopia Guji, washed process, tasting notes of bergamot, peach and black tea, roasted in small batches, out this Friday. Make a 20 s square (1080x1080) release video for Instagram. Calm, crafted, warm. Sound on.

Railyard is a payments API for developers: one API call moves money between bank accounts with instant settlement, and it sends a webhook at every state change. Make a 15 s 1920x1080 launch film for the homepage and social. Claims allowed: only those above. Sound on.

Substation is a two-night techno festival in a decommissioned power station (12-13 June). Make a 15 s 1080x1920 line-up reveal for Instagram/TikTok announcing these acts: Ancient Methods, Paula Temple, DVS1, Héctor Oaks, Rrose, Phase Fatale, Kia, Ida Engberg. Tickets on sale Friday. Sound on.

Burrow is a bedtime-story app for children aged 3-7: parents and kids make a new illustrated story together every night, read aloud by the app. Make a 20 s 1920x1080 launch film for parents. Sound on.

Make a 30 s 1920x1080 explainer on Arctic sea ice: September minimum extent 1979 to today. Use the real NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 data (https://noaadata.apps.nsidc.org/NOAA/G02135/north/monthly/data/N_09_extent_v4.0.csv), cite it on screen, and make the trend undeniable. Audience: a newspaper's social feed. Sound on.

Atelier Vauclair, an independent Swiss watchmaker, announces the Calibre 9: 38 mm steel case, hand-finished guilloché dial, 72-hour power reserve, limited to 150 pieces. Make a 12 s 1920x1080 teaser. Sound on.
Offset is a design-systems conference, Lisbon, 14-15 May 2027. Make the 15 s 1920x1080 opening title sequence that plays on the main stage before the first keynote. Sound on.

The Natural History Museum is opening 'Deep Time', an exhibition about the 300 million years of life before the dinosaurs (the Cambrian explosion, the first forests, the Great Dying). Make a 20 s 1920x1080 exhibition trailer for screens in the Underground and online. Opens 3 April. Sound on.
